name: synths
description: WAVE, a wavetable synth (7 banks, a super saw and a saw, Digital mode, ladder and OB filters, 2 LFOs with a Bipolar/Unipolar switch, a mod envelope and a Mod Matrix), in place of one synth model per project: Config > Project Settings > Synth Engines > WAVE replaces (Off, ACD, FAT, VAP, WTFM, PERC); the Model list then shows WAVE, with its own controls

branches.note: Config menu constructor: Project Settings folder, room for one more item
Config menu constructor: last item (Licenses); then adds the Synth Engines folder (WAVE replaces) to Project Settings, and resets the audio side (WAVE silent until the Pattern screen runs)
synth manager constructor: the model registry's builder 0x60140150, then WAVE inserted as model 3
project load: synth_slots_apply_project_q 0x600b2080, after the project's synths.bin has mapped the replaced model index to WAVE (table 0x200006b4)
synth settings screen: disp_ctrl_set_data for the Model list; with a swap, the patch's image ids
list control draw: image items 0x6010645c, then WAVE's name as text in the row the patch's ids mark
Edit Patch screen: disp_ctrl_set_text for the model logo label (""); for a WAVE synth, no logo and the text WAVE

words.note: VAP voice vtable +0x04: deleting destructor 0x6014b725 -> mt_syn_voice_delete (frees the engine voice)
VAP voice vtable +0x08: MIDI message 0x6014a9a9 -> mt_syn_voice_midi (the engine's notes, then VAP's)
VAP voice vtable +0x0c: set parameter 0x6014a8f1 -> mt_syn_voice_set_param (a WAVE voice's to the slot's copy only; others to VAP)
VAP voice vtable +0x10: render 0x6014a8b1 -> mt_syn_voice_render (the wavetable engine for a WAVE voice, else VAP)
VAP voice vtable +0x18: sounding 0x6014a81d -> mt_syn_voice_sounding (the engine's amp envelope for a WAVE voice, else VAP's)
patch storage vtable +0x0c: load into a patch 0x60124f39 (Workspace and Patches) -> mt_syn_patch_load (a WAVE patch's Polarity switches to Bipolar first, as a file saved before them holds none)
Pattern screen vtable: update method 0x600e1f99 -> mt_syn_pattern_update (settings file save; the unit has booted; applies a menu change)
Config screen vtable: update method 0x600c6475 -> mt_syn_config_update (settings file save; applies a menu change: the model table, the affected slots' models)
